label: Not clearly closed to state agencies
why: An agency cannot apply when the notice excludes state governments; unknown stays visible with a check-eligibility badge.

label: Fit with the agency plan
why: The closer the notice reads to what the agency's own strategic plan says it wants to do the more likely it is worth a grant writer's time.
source: Quest brief: match opportunities to agency strategic goals

label: Award size
why: A larger award pays for more of the plan; off by default so a big award does not outrank a good fit.
source: Team default for Nov 7 build [from notes; confirm with Kent]

label: No cost share
why: A grant that needs no state match is easier for a small agency to take on.
source: Team default for Nov 7 build [from notes; confirm with Kent]

label: Time to apply
why: More days before the close date means more time to write; rolling or unlisted dates count as unknown.
